integrity: The mathematical derivation is included; rational finite enumeration is supporting verification rather than proof of the general limit. Historical uniqueness is not certified. No independent scientific review has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled chord diagrams only; discrete shorter-arc endpoint span, not Euclidean chord length; asymptotic weak convergence has no claimed rate. Earlier crossing variance and single-chord degree formulas are prior results. The recorded source day is the first public arXiv posting of the principal span-definition source; an earlier supporting crossing paper is only day-unresolved (March 2000) and is not assigned an invented day.
title: Joint Gaussian fluctuations of total circular chord span and crossings
